stepBody: Carisma wants to determine whether she is spending more money on coffee compared to boba over the course of $$1$$ semester (15 weeks long). Assume she purchases $$4$$ coffees and $$3$$ bobas per week. Complete the following lines of code, which should assign $$\texttt{result}$$ to True if Carisma spends strictly more on coffee and False otherwise.\n$$\texttt{cost\_coffee}$$ $$=$$ $$6.0$$\n$$\texttt{cost\_boba}$$ $$=$$ $$7.0$$
